cond_0001.intro: The ideal candidate will contribute to the overall success of the organization by effectively managing the Business Office in providing timely and accurate information and outputs that allow the school to advance the mission in the most effective and comprehensive manner. The position oversees the functions of accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid and all tax filings. The Director of Finance also generates policies to ensure legal compliance and safeguarding of assets; finds creative solutions to organizational problems; and supervises the business operations team to deliver with compassion and integrity.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Maintains system and documentation of internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Manages all financial policies, provides financial services, prepares financial reports, appraises and reports on the results of operations in accordance with GAAP.
Advises the Head of School and/or the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or required by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Ensures timely, complete and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger to provide the information needed for effective management of the organization.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and such other audits of financial accounting data as may be required. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis.
Directly supervises administrative Business Office team members including tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to service internal clients.
Responsible for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics.
5+ Years of experience in finance or accounting.
Knowledge in GAAP.
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, delegate and work with tight deadlines.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree and/or CPA.
CMA designation.

The position oversees the functions of accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid and all tax filings. The Director of Finance also generates policies to ensure legal compliance and safeguarding of assets; finds creative solutions to organizational problems; and supervises the business operations team to deliver with compassion and integrity.
cond_0021.responsibilities:
Maintains system and documentation of internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Manages all financial policies, provides financial services, prepares financial reports, appraises and reports on the results of operations in accordance with GAAP.
Advises the Head of School and/or the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or required by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Ensures timely, complete and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger to provide the information needed for effective management of the organization.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and such other audits of financial accounting data as may be required. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis.
Directly supervises administrative Business Office team members including tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to service internal clients.
Responsible for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0021.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of experience in finance or accounting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of GAAP.
Ability to communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally.
Willingness to manage competing priorities and work collaboratively across teams.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree and/or CPA or CMA designation, or willingness to obtain.
Background in analytical work and comfort with financial reporting and data review.

The Director of Finance also generates policies to ensure legal compliance and safeguarding of assets; finds creative solutions to organizational problems; and supervises the business operations team to deliver with compassion and integrity.
cond_0254.responsibilities:
Maintains system and documentation of internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Manages all financial policies, provides financial services, prepares financial reports, appraises and reports on the results of operations in accordance with GAAP.
Advises the Head of School and/or the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or required by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Ensures timely, complete and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger to provide the information needed for effective management of the organization.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and such other audits of financial accounting data as may be required. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis.
Directly supervises administrative Business Office team members including tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to service internal clients.
Responsible for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0254.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics required.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in finance or accounting.
Advanced knowledge of GAAP.
Exceptional communication and analytical skills.
Proven ability to manage competing priorities, delegate effectively, and deliver under tight deadlines.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree and/or CPA strongly preferred.
CMA designation.

cond_0286.intro: We are looking for a Director of Finance to join our team. The role oversees the Business Office and is responsible for providing accurate, timely financial information that supports the school's mission. Core areas include accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid, and tax filings. The Director also develops policies to ensure legal compliance and asset safeguarding, identifies solutions to operational problems, and supervises the business operations team.
cond_0286.responsibilities:
Maintains system and documentation of internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems, and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Manages all financial policies, provides financial services, prepares financial reports, and appraises and reports on the results of operations in accordance with GAAP.
Advises the Head of School and/or the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or be required by the IRS, FASB, AICPA, or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Ensures timely, complete, and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts, and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger to provide the information needed for effective management of the organization.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and such other audits of financial accounting data as may be required. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis.
Directly supervises administrative Business Office team members covering tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training to support internal service continuity.
Responsible for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other assigned projects and provides ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0286.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics required; Master's and/or CPA preferred.
5+ Years of experience in finance or accounting.
Knowledge of GAAP; CMA designation.
Strong written communication and analytical skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, delegate, and meet tight deadlines.

In this role, you will work with the business operations team to support the school's mission by helping ensure timely and accurate financial information and outputs. Together with your team, you will help oversee accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid, and tax filings. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to service internal clients.
Shares responsibility for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.

cond_0387.intro: We are looking for a Director of Finance to join our team. In this role, you will work with the business operations team to support the school's mission by helping ensure timely and accurate financial information and outputs. Together with your team, you will help oversee accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid, and tax filings. You will also work collaboratively to develop policies that support legal compliance and asset safeguarding, and help find solutions to organizational challenges.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Maintains system and documentation of internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Coordinates all financial policies, supports the delivery of financial services, prepares financial reports, and works with leadership to appraise and report on the results of operations in accordance with GAAP.
Advises the Head of School and/or the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or required by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Helps ensure timely, complete and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger to provide the information needed for effective management of the organization.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and such other audits of financial accounting data as may be required. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis.
Directly supervises and supports administrative Business Office team members including tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to service internal clients.
Shares responsibility for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns in a timely manner.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics.
5+ Years of experience in finance or accounting.
Knowledge of GAAP.
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, delegate, and work with tight deadlines.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree and/or CPA.
CMA designation.

This includes accounting, audit, payroll, family billing, budgeting, payables, procurement, financial aid, and tax filings. The Director of Finance also develops policies to ensure legal compliance and asset safeguarding, works with others to find solutions to organizational problems, and leads the business operations team with compassion and integrity.
cond_0411.responsibilities:
Maintains and communicates internal controls, accounting policies and procedures, accounting systems, and financial reporting systems for [Company name masked] and the School Foundation.
Manages all financial policies, provides financial services, prepares financial reports, and regularly discusses the results of operations with relevant stakeholders in accordance with GAAP.
Actively advises the Head of School and the [Company name masked] Board of Directors on potential or desirable operational changes that may result from or be required by the IRS, FASB, AICPA, or other authoritative bodies affecting [Company name masked].
Ensures timely, complete, and accurate accounting for all transactions, timely reconciliations of balance sheet accounts, and appropriate coding and approval of expenses in the general ledger. Stays in regular contact with management to provide the information needed for effective decision-making.
Coordinates the annual audit of [Company name masked] operations and any other required audits of financial accounting data. Coordinates the annual 990 tax filing.
Oversees the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports, including appropriate analysis, and walks stakeholders through findings as needed.
Directly supervises administrative Business Office team members covering tuition billing and receipts, procurement and payables, general ledger management, the financial aid process, payroll compliance, and spirit store inventory management. Arranges for cross-training as appropriate to serve internal clients and keeps open communication across the team.
Responsible for hiring, training, and evaluating all Business Office staff. Conducts annual performance reviews and addresses concerns promptly.
Serves on the Finance Committee of the School Board, actively contributing to discussions and raising issues as they arise.
Supports other projects as assigned, and ad hoc analyses as needed for business decision-making.
cond_0411.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics required; Master's and/or CPA preferred.
5+ Years of experience in finance or accounting.
Knowledge in GAAP, CMA designation.
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, delegate, and work with tight deadlines.
cond_0411.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0411.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.
